lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن التفضيلات. البنية: I prefer tea to coffee. (أفضّل الشاي على القهوة.). I prefer A to B. I like A better than B. My favorite is…

dialogue.textEn: I like pizza better than pasta.
My favorite dessert is ice cream.
Prefer, better than, favorite, dessert — express your taste.
dialogue.textAr: prefer، better than، favorite، dessert — عبّر عن ذوقك.

dialogue.textEn: prefer! I prefer tea to coffee.
better than! I like pizza better than pasta.
dialogue.textAr: أفضل من! أحب Pizza أفضل من Pasta.

dialogue.textEn: favorite! My favorite dessert is ice cream.
dialogue.textAr: مفضل! حلوى المفضلة هي ice cream.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I like pizza better than pasta.
My favorite dessert is ice cream.

quiz.explanationAr: prefer تعني «يفضّل». مثال: I prefer tea to coffee.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: I like pizza ___ pasta.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: better than. أحب Pizza أفضل من Pasta.
الترتيب الصحيح: I prefer tea to coffee.
dessert تعني «حلوى». مثال: I’d like a dessert.
better than تعني «أفضل من». مثال: I like pizza better than pasta.

lessons.title: Past Simple — Regular Verbs
lessons.descriptionAr: worked، played، visited، watched — إضافة ed.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: سرد أحداث Vergangenheit (أمس). البنية: I worked and visited my friend yesterday. (عملت وقمت بزيارة صديقي أمس.). Subject + verb + ed. نفي: didn’t + verb. سؤال: Did + Subject + verb?

dialogue.textEn: Worked, played, visited, watched — the past is yours.
dialogue.textAr: worked، played، visited، watched — Vergangenheit ملكك.

quiz.explanationAr: worked تعني «عمل (ماضي)». مثال: I worked yesterday.
الإجابة الصحيحة: played. لعبنا football.

quiz.correctAnswer: I worked and visited my friend yesterday.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I worked and visited my friend yesterday.
watched تعني «شاهد (ماضي)». مثال: We watched a movie.
played تعني «لعب (ماضي)». مثال: We played football.

lessons.title: Past Simple — Irregular Verbs
lessons.descriptionAr: went، saw، ate، had — أفعال شاذة.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام الأفعال الشاذة في Vergangenheit. البنية: I went to the park and saw my friend. (ذهبت للحديقة ورأيت صديقي.). أفعال شاذة: go→went, see→saw, eat→ate, have→had (لا ed).

dialogue.textEn: Let us learn irregular past verbs.
Went, saw, ate, had — irregular but easy.
dialogue.textAr: went، saw، ate، had — شاذة لكن سهلة.

dialogue.textEn: went! I went to the park.

quiz.explanationAr: went تعني «ذهب (ماضي)». مثال: I went to the park.
الإجابة الصحيحة: saw. رأيت فيلمًا.

quiz.correctAnswer: I went to the park and saw my friend.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I went to the park and saw my friend.
had تعني «كان لديه (ماضي)». مثال: She had a cat.
saw تعني «رأى (ماضي)». مثال: I saw a movie.

lessons.title: Time Expressions (Past)
lessons.descriptionAr: yesterday، last week، ago، last year.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: تحديد وقت حدث Vergangenheit. البنية: I traveled last year. (سافرت العام الماضي.). yesterday, last week/month/year, ago. ago + عدد + وحدة (two days ago).

dialogue.textEn: I bought it two days ago.
Yesterday, last week, ago — talk about the past.
dialogue.textAr: yesterday، last week، ago — تحدث عن Vergangenheit.

dialogue.textEn: last week! I visited last week.
dialogue.textAr: الأسبوع الماضي! قمت بزيارة الأسبوع الماضي.

dialogue.textEn: ago! I bought it two days ago.
last year! I traveled last year.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I bought it two days ago.

quiz.explanationAr: yesterday تعني «أمس». مثال: I worked yesterday.
الإجابة الصحيحة: last week. قمت بزيارة الأسبوع الماضي.
الترتيب الصحيح: I traveled last year.
last year تعني «العام الماضي». مثال: I traveled last year.
last week تعني «الأسبوع الماضي». مثال: I visited last week.

lessons.title: Telling a Short Story
lessons.descriptionAr: first، then، finally، suddenly — سرد قصة.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: سرد قصة قصيرة بترتيب (First → Then → Finally). البنية: First he went to the park, then he saw a dog. (أولاً ذهب للحديقة، ثم رأى كلبًا.). استخدم Past Simple + First/Then/Finally/Suddenly.

dialogue.textEn: First, he went to the park.
First, then, finally — tell your own story.
first! First, he went to the park.
then! Then he saw a dog.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: First, he went to the park.

quiz.explanationAr: first تعني «أولاً». مثال: First, he went to the park.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: ___ he saw a dog.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: then. ثم رأى كلبًا.

quiz.promptAr: أولاً ذهب للحديقة، ثم رأى كلبًا.
quiz.correctAnswer: First he went to the park, then he saw a dog.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: First he went to the park, then he saw a dog.
suddenly تعني «فجأة». مثال: Suddenly, it rained.
then تعني «ثم». مثال: Then he saw a dog.

lessons.title: Future with "going to"
lessons.descriptionAr: going to، plan، travel، tomorrow — خطط.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن الخطط (going to). البنية: I am going to study tomorrow. (سأدرس غدًا.). Subject + am/is/are + going to + verb. للخطط.

dialogue.textEn: What are you going to do?
going to! I am going to study.
travel! She is going to travel.
tomorrow! I will meet you tomorrow.

quiz.explanationAr: going to تعني «سي/ست (خطة)». مثال: I am going to study.
الإجابة الصحيحة: plan. لدي خطة.

quiz.correctAnswer: I am going to study tomorrow.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I am going to study tomorrow.
tomorrow تعني «غدًا». مثال: I will meet you tomorrow.
plan تعني «خطة». مثال: I have a plan.

lessons.title: Future with "will"
lessons.descriptionAr: will، won’t، decide، promise — قرارات وتنبؤات.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: اتخاذ قرارات ووعود (will/won’t). البنية: I’ll help you tomorrow. (سأساعدك غدًا.). Subject + will + verb (base). قرارات/تنبؤات. نفي: won’t. اختصار: I’ll.

dialogue.textEn: Let us make decisions and promises.

quiz.explanationAr: will تعني «س (قرار/تنبؤ)». مثال: I will help you.
الإجابة الصحيحة: won’t. هي لن تأتي.
الترتيب الصحيح: I’ll help you tomorrow.
promise تعني «وعد». مثال: I promise to help.
won’t تعني «لن (نفي)». مثال: She won’t come.

lessons.title: Booking & Appointments
lessons.descriptionAr: book، appointment، available، confirm.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: حجز طاولة/موعد وتأكيده. البنية: I’d like to book a table. (أود حجز طاولة.). I’d like to book + اسم. Can I make an appointment? What time is available?

dialogue.textEn: I’d like to book a table.
Book, appointment, available, confirm — you can reserve.
dialogue.textAr: book، appointment، available، confirm — تستطيع الحجز.

dialogue.textEn: book! I’d like to book a table.
appointment! Can I make an appointment?
available! Is there an available table?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I’d like to book a table.

quiz.explanationAr: book تعني «يحجز». مثال: I’d like to book a table.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: Can I make an ___?
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: appointment. هل يمكنني تحديد موعد؟

quiz.correctAnswer: I’d like to book a table.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I’d like to book a table.
confirm تعني «يؤكد». مثال: I’ll confirm your booking.
appointment تعني «موعد». مثال: Can I make an appointment?

lessons.title: Time Prepositions (Review)
lessons.descriptionAr: in، on، at، noon — مراجعة.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام in/on/at للوقت. البنية: I wake up at 7 in the morning. (أستيقظ في 7 في الصباح.). in + شهر/سنة/جزء يوم. on + يوم/تاريخ. at + ساعة/لحظة.

dialogue.textEn: Let us use in, on, at for time.
I wake up in the morning.
In, on, at — time is clear now.
dialogue.textAr: in، on، at — الوقت واضح الآن.

dialogue.textEn: in! I wake up in the morning.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I wake up in the morning.

quiz.explanationAr: in تعني «في (شهر/سنة/جزء يوم)». مثال: I wake up in the morning.
الإجابة الصحيحة: on. أعمل يوم الاثنين.

quiz.correctAnswer: I wake up at 7 in the morning.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I wake up at 7 in the morning.
noon تعني «ظهر». مثال: I eat at noon.
on تعني «في (يوم/تاريخ)». مثال: I work on Monday.

lessons.title: Present Continuous
lessons.descriptionAr: I am working، She is reading.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: وصف ما يحدث الآن. البنية: I am working now. (أنا أعمل الآن.). Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing. now, at the moment.

dialogue.textEn: I am busy at the moment.
am working! I am working now.
is reading! She is reading a book.
are playing! They are playing football.
Can you say at the moment?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول في هذه اللحظة؟

dialogue.textEn: at the moment! I am busy at the moment.
dialogue.textAr: في هذه اللحظة! أنا مشغول في هذه اللحظة.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I am busy at the moment.

quiz.explanationAr: am working تعني «أعمل (الآن)». مثال: I am working now.
الإجابة الصحيحة: is reading. هي تقرأ كتابًا.
الترتيب الصحيح: I am working now.
at the moment تعني «في هذه اللحظة». مثال: I am busy at the moment.
is reading تعني «تقرأ (الآن)». مثال: She is reading a book.

lessons.title: Past Continuous
lessons.descriptionAr: I was working، She was reading.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: وصف ما كان يحدث. البنية: I was working at 8 PM. (كنت أعمل في 8 مساءً.). Subject + was/were + verb-ing. when, while.

dialogue.textEn: I was reading when he called.
While I was cooking, he arrived.
was working! I was working at 8 PM.
dialogue.textAr: كنت أعمل! كنت أعمل في 8 مساءً.

dialogue.textEn: were playing! They were playing football.
when! I was reading when he called.
while! While I was cooking, he arrived.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I was reading when he called.
While I was cooking, he arrived.

quiz.explanationAr: was working تعني «كنت أعمل». مثال: I was working at 8 PM.
الإجابة الصحيحة: were playing. كانوا يلعبون football.
الترتيب الصحيح: I was working at 8 PM.
while تعني «بينما». مثال: While I was cooking, he arrived.
were playing تعني «كانوا يلعبون». مثال: They were playing football.

lessons.title: Present Perfect
lessons.descriptionAr: I have visited، She has finished.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التحدث عن خبرة/نتيجة. البنية: I have visited Paris. (لقد زرت Paris.). have/has + past participle. for/since, just/already/yet.

dialogue.textEn: I have lived here for 5 years.
Present Perfect — express experience and result.
dialogue.textAr: المضارع التام — عبّر عن خبرة ونتيجة.

dialogue.textEn: have visited! I have visited Paris.
has finished! She has finished her homework.
for! I have lived here for 5 years.
since! I have worked here since 2020.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I have lived here for 5 years.

quiz.explanationAr: have visited تعني «زار (خبرة)». مثال: I have visited Paris.
الإجابة الصحيحة: has finished. أنهت واجبها.
الترتيب الصحيح: I have visited Paris.
since تعني «من». مثال: I have worked here since 2020.
has finished تعني «أنهى (نتيجة)». مثال: She has finished her homework.

lessons.title: Modal Verbs
lessons.descriptionAr: can، must، should، may، might.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن القدرة/الضرورة/الإذن. البنية: You must study. (يجب أن تدرس.). can (قدرة)، must (ضرورة)، should (نصيحة)، may/might (إحتمال)، could (طلب).

dialogue.textEn: Can, must, should, may — express ability and need.
dialogue.textAr: can، must، should، may — عبّر عن القدرة والضرورة.

quiz.explanationAr: can تعني «أستطيع». مثال: I can swim.
الإجابة الصحيحة: must. يجب أن تدرس.
الترتيب الصحيح: You must study.
may تعني «قد (إحتمال)». مثال: It may rain.
must تعني «يجب». مثال: You must study.

lessons.title: Comparatives
lessons.descriptionAr: bigger، more expensive، better.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: مقارنة الأشياء. البنية: This book is bigger than that one. (هذا الكتاب أكبر من ذلك.). short adj + er + than. long adj: more + adj + than. irregular: better, worse.

dialogue.textEn: Bigger, more expensive, better than — compare.
dialogue.textAr: bigger، more expensive، better than — قارن.

dialogue.textEn: more expensive! This car is more expensive.
dialogue.textAr: أكثر تكلفة! هذه السيارة أكثر تكلفة.

dialogue.textEn: better! Tea is better than coffee.
than! She is taller than him.

quiz.explanationAr: bigger تعني «أكبر». مثال: This book is bigger.
الإجابة الصحيحة: more expensive. هذه السيارة أكثر تكلفة.

quiz.correctAnswer: This book is bigger than that one.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: This book is bigger than that one.
than تعني «من (مقارنة)». مثال: She is taller than him.
more expensive تعني «أكثر تكلفة». مثال: This car is more expensive.

lessons.title: Superlatives
lessons.descriptionAr: biggest، most expensive، best.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن الأفضل. البنية: This is the biggest book. (هذا هو أكبر كتاب.). short adj + est. long adj: most + adj. irregular: best, worst.

dialogue.textEn: This is the most expensive car.
Biggest, most expensive, best, worst — express the extreme.
dialogue.textAr: biggest، most expensive، best، worst — عبّر عن الأقصى.

dialogue.textEn: biggest! This is the biggest book.
most expensive! This is the most expensive car.
dialogue.textAr: الأكثر تكلفة! هذه هي السيارة الأكثر تكلفة.

dialogue.textEn: best! This is the best movie.
worst! This is the worst day.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: This is the most expensive car.

quiz.explanationAr: biggest تعني «الأكبر». مثال: This is the biggest book.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: This is the ___ car.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: most expensive. هذه هي السيارة الأكثر تكلفة.
الترتيب الصحيح: This is the biggest book.
worst تعني «الأسوأ». مثال: This is the worst day.
most expensive تعني «الأكثر تكلفة». مثال: This is the most expensive car.

lessons.title: Countable & Uncountable
lessons.descriptionAr: some/any مع countable/uncountable.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التمييز بين countable و uncountable. البنية: I have some books and some water. (لدي بعض الكتب وبعض الماء.). Countable: a book, books (some/many). Uncountable: water, rice (some/much). some (إيجابي)، any (سؤال/نفي).

dialogue.textEn: Let us count or not count.
Some, any, much, many — count or not.
dialogue.textAr: some، any، much، many — عد أو لا.

dialogue.textEn: any! Do you have any water?
much! I don’t have much time.
dialogue.textAr: كثير (غير محسوس)! ليس لدي وقت كثير.

quiz.explanationAr: some تعني «بعض». مثال: I have some books.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: Do you have ___ water?
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: any. هل لديك ماء؟

quiz.correctAnswer: I have some books and some water.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I have some books and some water.
many تعني «كثير (محسوس)». مثال: There are many students.
any تعني «أي». مثال: Do you have any water?

lessons.title: A few / A little
lessons.descriptionAr: A few (محسوس)، A little (غير محسوس).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن كمية small. البنية: I have a few books and a little water. (لدي بعض الكتب وقليل من الماء.). a few + countable (some). a little + uncountable (some). few/little (negative).

dialogue.textEn: A few, a little — express small amounts.
dialogue.textAr: a few، a little — عبّر عن small amounts.

dialogue.textEn: a few! I have a few books.
a little! I have a little water.
dialogue.textAr: قليل (غير محسوس)! لدي قليل من الماء.
قليل (محسوس, negative)! قليل من الطلاب جاء.
هل يمكنك قول قليل (غير محسوس, negative)؟
قليل (غير محسوس, negative)! وقت قليل متبق.

quiz.explanationAr: a few تعني «بعض (محسوس)». مثال: I have a few books.
الإجابة الصحيحة: a little. لدي قليل من الماء.

quiz.promptAr: لدي بعض الكتب وقليل من الماء.
quiz.correctAnswer: I have a few books and a little water.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I have a few books and a little water.
little تعني «قليل (غير محسوس, negative)». مثال: Little time is left.
a little تعني «قليل (غير محسوس)». مثال: I have a little water.

lessons.title: Too / Enough
lessons.descriptionAr: too big، enough time.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن "أكثر من اللازم" / "كافي". البنية: The box is too heavy. (الصندوق ثقيل جدًا.). too + adj (أكثر من اللازم). adj + enough (كافي). enough + noun.

dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول جدًا (أكثر من اللازم)؟

dialogue.textEn: too! The box is too heavy.
dialogue.textAr: جدًا (أكثر من اللازم)! الصندوق ثقيل جدًا.
هل يمكنك قول كثير جدًا (غير محسوس)؟
كثير جدًا (غير محسوس)! سكر كثير جدًا.
هل يمكنك قول جدًا (أكثر من اللازم)؟

quiz.explanationAr: too تعني «جدًا (أكثر من اللازم)». مثال: The box is too heavy.
الإجابة الصحيحة: enough. لدي enough money.
الترتيب الصحيح: The box is too heavy.
too many تعني «كثير جدًا (محسوس)». مثال: Too many cars.
enough تعني «كافي». مثال: I have enough money.

lessons.title: So / Such
lessons.descriptionAr: so + adj، such + noun.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التشديد على صفة/اسم. البنية: It is so hot. (إنها حارة جدًا.). so + adj/adverb. such + (a/an) + adj + noun. so + adj + that…

dialogue.textEn: It is such a beautiful day.
She is such a kind person.
such! It is such a beautiful day.
dialogue.textAr: مثل هذا! إنها such a beautiful day.

dialogue.textEn: so much! I have so much work.
dialogue.textAr: كثير جدًا! لدي so much work.

dialogue.textEn: such a! She is such a kind person.
dialogue.textAr: مثل هذا (أ)! هي such a kind person.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: It is such a beautiful day.
She is such a kind person.

quiz.explanationAr: so تعني «جدًا». مثال: It is so hot.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: It is ___ a beautiful day.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: such. إنها such a beautiful day.
الترتيب الصحيح: It is so hot.
such a تعني «مثل هذا (أ)». مثال: She is such a kind person.
such تعني «مثل هذا». مثال: It is such a beautiful day.

lessons.title: Question Tags
lessons.descriptionAr: You’re coming, aren’t you?
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: تكوين ذيل سؤال. البنية: You’re coming, aren’t you? (أنت قادم، أليس كذلك؟). Statement + opposite tag. Positive statement → negative tag. Negative statement → positive tag.

dialogue.textEn: aren’t you! You’re coming, aren’t you?
dialogue.textAr: أليس كذلك؟ (أنت)! أنت قادم، أليس كذلك؟
هل يمكنك قول أليس كذلك؟ (أنت، إعجاب)؟

dialogue.textEn: don’t you! You like tea, don’t you?
dialogue.textAr: أليس كذلك؟ (أنت، إعجاب)! تحب الشاي، أليس كذلك؟

dialogue.textEn: isn’t it! It’s hot, isn’t it?
dialogue.textAr: أليس كذلك؟ (هو/هي)! إنها حارة، أليس كذلك؟

quiz.explanationAr: aren’t you تعني «أليس كذلك؟ (أنت)». مثال: You’re coming, aren’t you?
الإجابة الصحيحة: don’t you. تحب الشاي، أليس كذلك؟
الترتيب الصحيح: You’re coming, aren’t you?
can you تعني «هل يمكنك؟ (سؤال)». مثال: Can you swim?
don’t you تعني «أليس كذلك؟ (أنت، إعجاب)». مثال: You like tea, don’t you?

lessons.title: Reported Speech
lessons.descriptionAr: He said that… / She told me…
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: نقل كلام (backshift). البنية: He said that he was happy. (قال إنه كان سعيدًا.). Direct → Reported: tense backshift. He said (that) + clause. today→that day, here→there.

dialogue.textEn: He said that he was happy.
She told me she would come.
Can you say he said that?
he said that! He said that he was happy.
dialogue.textAr: قال إن! قال إنه كان سعيدًا.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say she told me?
she told me! She told me she would come.
was happy! He said he was happy.
dialogue.textAr: كانت سعيدة! قال إنه كان سعيدًا.

dialogue.textEn: would come! She said she would come.
Can you say he said that?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: He said that he was happy.
She told me she would come.

quiz.explanationAr: he said that تعني «قال إن». مثال: He said that he was happy.
الإجابة الصحيحة: she told me. أخبرتني أنها ستأتي.

quiz.correctAnswer: He said that he was happy.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: He said that he was happy.
would come تعني «سيأتي (منقول)». مثال: She said she would come.
she told me تعني «أخبرتني». مثال: She told me she would come.

lessons.title: Passive Voice
lessons.descriptionAr: The book was written. The car is made.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام المبني للمجهول. البنية: The book was written by her. (كُتب الكتاب by her.). Subject + be + past participle (+ by agent). is made, was written, are sold.

dialogue.textEn: The book was written by her.
The car is made in Japan.
The book was written by her.
Passive voice — focus on the action.
was written! The book was written by her.
is made! The car is made in Japan.
are sold! These books are sold here.
by! The book was written by her.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The book was written by her.
The car is made in Japan.
The book was written by her.

quiz.explanationAr: was written تعني «كُتب (ماضي)». مثال: The book was written by her.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: The car ___ in Japan.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: is made. السيارة تُصنع في اليابان.

quiz.correctAnswer: The book was written by her.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: The book was written by her.
by تعني «by (فاعل)». مثال: The book was written by her.
is made تعني «يُصنع». مثال: The car is made in Japan.

lessons.title: Relative Clauses
lessons.descriptionAr: who، which، that.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: ربط الجمل (who, which, that). البنية: The man who called is my friend. (الرجل الذي اتصل صديقي.). who (شخص)، which (شيء)، that (كلاهما). The man who… The book which…

dialogue.textEn: The man who called is my friend.
The book which I read is great.
The car that broke down is old.
The student whose bag is lost…
who! The man who called is my friend.
which! The book which I read is great.
that! The car that broke down is old.
whose! The student whose bag is lost…

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The man who called is my friend.
The book which I read is great.
The car that broke down is old.
The student whose bag is lost…

quiz.explanationAr: who تعني «الذي (شخص)». مثال: The man who called is my friend.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: The book ___ I read is great.
quiz.questionEn: The book ___ I read is great.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: which. الكتاب الذي قرأته رائع.

quiz.correctAnswer: The man who called is my friend.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: The man who called is my friend.
whose تعني «التي (ملكية)». مثال: The student whose bag is lost…
which تعني «الذي (شيء)». مثال: The book which I read is great.

lessons.title: First Conditional
lessons.descriptionAr: If + present, will + base.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن احتمال مستقبلي. البنية: If it rains, I will stay home. (إذا أمطرت، سأبقى في المنزل.). If + Present Simple, will + base verb. unless, as long as.

dialogue.textEn: If it rains, I will stay home.
Unless you study, you will fail.
As long as you try, you’ll succeed.
If, will, unless, as long as — express possibility.
dialogue.textAr: if، will، unless، as long as — عبّر عن احتمال.

dialogue.textEn: if! If it rains, I will stay home.
dialogue.textAr: إذا! إذا أمطرت، سأبقى في المنزل.

dialogue.textEn: unless! Unless you study, you will fail.
dialogue.textAr: ما لم! ما لم تدرس، ستفشل.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say as long as?
as long as! As long as you try, you’ll succeed.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: If it rains, I will stay home.
Unless you study, you will fail.
As long as you try, you’ll succeed.

quiz.explanationAr: if تعني «إذا». مثال: If it rains, I will stay home.
الإجابة الصحيحة: will. سأبقى في المنزل.

quiz.correctAnswer: If it rains, I will stay home.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: If it rains, I will stay home.
as long as تعني «طالما». مثال: As long as you try, you’ll succeed.
will تعني «س (احتمال)». مثال: I will stay home.

lessons.title: Second Conditional
lessons.descriptionAr: If + past, would + base (تخيل).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن تخيل/أحلام. البنية: If I won the lottery, I would travel. (لو فزت باليانصيب، سأسافر.). If + Past Simple, would + base. For dreams/unreal. If I were rich…

dialogue.textEn: If I won, I would travel.
If only I had more time.
dialogue.textAr: لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

dialogue.textEn: would! If I won, I would travel.
if only! If only I had more time.
dialogue.textAr: لو فقط! لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

dialogue.textEn: suppose! Suppose you had a million.
wish! I wish I could fly.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: If I won, I would travel.
If only I had more time.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

quiz.explanationAr: would تعني «would (تخيل)». مثال: If I won, I would travel.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: ___ I had more time.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: if only. لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

quiz.correctAnswer: If I won the lottery, I would travel.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: If I won the lottery, I would travel.
wish تعني «أتمنى». مثال: I wish I could fly.
if only تعني «لو فقط». مثال: If only I had more time.

lessons.title: Wishes
lessons.descriptionAr: I wish I were rich. I wish I had known.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن التمني (present/past). البنية: I wish I were taller. (أتمنى أن أكون أطول.). I wish + Past Simple (regret about present). I wish + Past Perfect (regret about past).

dialogue.textEn: I wish I had known earlier.
If only I had more time.
dialogue.textAr: لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

dialogue.textEn: I wish, were, had known, if only — express wishes.
dialogue.textAr: I wish، were، had known، if only — عبّر عن التمني.

dialogue.textEn: I wish! I wish I were taller.
were! I wish I were rich.
had known! I wish I had known earlier.
dialogue.textAr: كنت أعلم (wish)! أتمنى لو كنت أعلم earlier.

dialogue.textEn: if only! If only I had more time.
dialogue.textAr: لو فقط! لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I wish I had known earlier.
If only I had more time.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

quiz.explanationAr: I wish تعني «أتمنى». مثال: I wish I were taller.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: I wish I ___ rich.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: were. أتمنى أن أكون غنيًا.
الترتيب الصحيح: I wish I were taller.
if only تعني «لو فقط». مثال: If only I had more time.
were تعني «كنت (wish)». مثال: I wish I were rich.

lessons.title: Expressions of Quantity
lessons.descriptionAr: a lot of، a few، a little، many، much.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن الكمية. البنية: I have a lot of books. (لدي الكثير من الكتب.). a lot of (كثير)، a few (بعض, countable)، a little (قليل, uncountable)، many (كثير, countable)، much (كثير, uncountable).

dialogue.textEn: I have a lot of books.
A lot of, a few, a little, many — express quantity.
dialogue.textAr: a lot of، a few، a little، many — عبّر عن كمية.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say a lot of?
a lot of! I have a lot of books.
dialogue.textAr: كثير من! لدي الكثير من الكتب.

dialogue.textEn: a few! I have a few friends.
a little! I have a little time.
dialogue.textAr: قليل (غير محسوس)! لدي قليل من الوقت.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say a lot of?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I have a lot of books.

quiz.explanationAr: a lot of تعني «كثير من». مثال: I have a lot of books.
الإجابة الصحيحة: a few. لدي بعض الأصدقاء.

quiz.correctAnswer: I have a lot of books.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I have a lot of books.
many تعني «كثير (محسوس)». مثال: There are many students.
a few تعني «بعض (محسوس)». مثال: I have a few friends.

lessons.title: Linking Words
lessons.descriptionAr: and، but، so، because.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: ربط الجمل. البنية: I am tired, but I will study. (أنا متعب، لكنني سأدرس.). and (و)، but (لكن)، so (لذلك)، because (لأن).

dialogue.textEn: I am tired, but I will study.
It rained, so I stayed home.
I stayed home because it rained.
And, but, so, because — link sentences.
dialogue.textAr: and، but، so، because — اربط الجمل.

dialogue.textEn: and! I like tea and coffee.
but! I am tired, but I will study.
so! It rained, so I stayed home.
dialogue.textAr: لذلك! أمطرت، لذلك بقيت في المنزل.

dialogue.textEn: because! I stayed home because it rained.
dialogue.textAr: لأن! بقيت في المنزل لأنها أمطرت.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I am tired, but I will study.
It rained, so I stayed home.
I stayed home because it rained.

quiz.explanationAr: and تعني «و». مثال: I like tea and coffee.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: I am tired, ___ I will study.
quiz.questionEn: I am tired, ___ I will study.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: but. أنا متعب، لكنني سأدرس.

quiz.correctAnswer: I am tired, but I will study.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I am tired, but I will study.
because تعني «لأن». مثال: I stayed home because it rained.
but تعني «لكن». مثال: I am tired, but I will study.

lessons.title: Connectors
lessons.descriptionAr: however، therefore، moreover، although.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: ربط الأفكار (متقدم). البنية: It rained; however, we went out. (أمطرت؛ ومع ذلك، خرجنا.). however (ومع ذلك)، therefore (لذلك)، moreover (علاوة على ذلك)، although (على الرغم من).

dialogue.textEn: It rained; however, we went out.
It rained; therefore, we stayed home.
It rained; moreover, it was cold.
dialogue.textAr: أمطرت؛ علاوة على ذلك، كانت باردة.

dialogue.textEn: Although it rained, we went out.
dialogue.textAr: على الرغم من أنها أمطرت، خرجنا.

dialogue.textEn: However, therefore, moreover, although — connect ideas.
dialogue.textAr: however، therefore، moreover، although — اربط الأفكار.

dialogue.textEn: however! It rained; however, we went out.
dialogue.textAr: ومع ذلك! أمطرت؛ ومع ذلك، خرجنا.

dialogue.textEn: therefore! It rained; therefore, we stayed home.
dialogue.textAr: لذلك! أمطرت؛ لذلك، بقينا في المنزل.
هل يمكنك قول علاوة على ذلك؟

dialogue.textEn: moreover! It rained; moreover, it was cold.
dialogue.textAr: علاوة على ذلك! أمطرت؛ علاوة على ذلك، كانت باردة.
هل يمكنك قول على الرغم من؟

dialogue.textEn: although! Although it rained, we went out.
dialogue.textAr: على الرغم من! على الرغم من أنها أمطرت، خرجنا.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: It rained; however, we went out.
It rained; therefore, we stayed home.
It rained; moreover, it was cold.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: أمطرت؛ علاوة على ذلك، كانت باردة.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: Although it rained, we went out.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: على الرغم من أنها أمطرت، خرجنا.

quiz.explanationAr: however تعني «ومع ذلك». مثال: It rained; however, we went out.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: It rained; ___, we stayed home.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: therefore. أمطرت؛ لذلك، بقينا في المنزل.

quiz.correctAnswer: It rained; however, we went out.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: It rained; however, we went out.
although تعني «على الرغم من». مثال: Although it rained, we went out.
therefore تعني «لذلك». مثال: It rained; therefore, we stayed home.

lessons.title: Time Expressions
lessons.descriptionAr: already، yet، just، still.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن الوقت (already/yet/just/still). البنية: I have already finished. (لقد أنهيت بالفعل.). already (بالفعل, إيجابي)، yet (بعد, سؤال/نفي)، just (للتو)، still (لا يزال).

dialogue.textEn: Already, yet, just, still — talk about time.
dialogue.textAr: already، yet، just، still — تحدث عن الوقت.
لا يزال! هو لا يزال هنا.

quiz.explanationAr: already تعني «بالفعل». مثال: I have already finished.
الإجابة الصحيحة: yet. هل أنهيت بعد؟
الترتيب الصحيح: I have already finished.
still تعني «لا يزال». مثال: He is still here.
yet تعني «بعد (سؤال/نفي)». مثال: Have you finished yet?

lessons.title: Frequency 2
lessons.descriptionAr: rarely، seldom، occasionally، often.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن تكرار (إضافي). البنية: I rarely eat fast food. (نادراً ما آكل fast food.). often (غالبًا)، rarely (نادراً)، seldom (نادراً)، occasionally (أحيانًا).

dialogue.textEn: I often go to the gym.
Often, rarely, seldom, occasionally — express frequency.
dialogue.textAr: often، rarely، seldom، occasionally — عبّر عن التكرار.

dialogue.textEn: often! I often go to the gym.
dialogue.textAr: غالبًا! أذهب إلى صالة الرياضة غالباً.

dialogue.textEn: rarely! I rarely eat fast food.
dialogue.textAr: نادراً! نادراً ما آكل fast food.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I often go to the gym.

quiz.explanationAr: often تعني «غالبًا». مثال: I often go to the gym.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: I ___ eat fast food.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: rarely. نادراً ما آكل fast food.
الترتيب الصحيح: I rarely eat fast food.
occasionally تعني «أحيانًا». مثال: We occasionally meet.
rarely تعني «نادراً». مثال: I rarely eat fast food.

lessons.title: Degree
lessons.descriptionAr: very، really، quite، rather.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التشديد على صفة. البنية: It is very hot. (إنها حارة جدًا.). very (جدًا)، really (حقاً)، quite (تماماً)، rather (إلى حد ما).

dialogue.textEn: Very, really, quite, rather — emphasize degree.
dialogue.textAr: very، really، quite، rather — شدد الدرجة.

dialogue.textEn: quite! The movie is quite good.

dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول إلى حد ما؟
إلى حد ما! إنها cold إلى حد ما.

quiz.explanationAr: very تعني «جدًا». مثال: It is very hot.
الإجابة الصحيحة: really. هي kind حقاً.
الترتيب الصحيح: It is very hot.
rather تعني «إلى حد ما». مثال: It’s rather cold.
really تعني «حقاً». مثال: She is really kind.

lessons.title: Intensifiers
lessons.descriptionAr: so، such، too، enough.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التشديد (إضافي). البنية: It is so hot. (إنها حارة جدًا.). so + adj/adverb. such + noun. too (أكثر من اللازم). enough (كافي).

dialogue.textEn: It is such a beautiful day.
such! It is such a beautiful day.
dialogue.textAr: مثل هذا! إنها such a beautiful day.
هل يمكنك قول جدًا (أكثر من اللازم)؟

dialogue.textEn: too! The box is too heavy.
dialogue.textAr: جدًا (أكثر من اللازم)! الصندوق ثقيل جدًا.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: It is such a beautiful day.

quiz.explanationAr: so تعني «جدًا». مثال: It is so hot.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: It is ___ a beautiful day.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: such. إنها such a beautiful day.
الترتيب الصحيح: It is so hot.
enough تعني «كافي». مثال: I have enough money.
such تعني «مثل هذا». مثال: It is such a beautiful day.

lessons.title: Emphasis (do/does/did)
lessons.descriptionAr: I do like، She does know.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التشديد على فعل. البنية: I do like tea. (أنا indeed أحب الشاي.). do/does/did + base verb للتشديد. I do like tea. She does know.

dialogue.textEn: does! She does know the answer.

quiz.explanationAr: do تعني «do (تشديد)». مثال: I do like tea.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: She ___ know the answer.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: does. هي indeed تعرف الإجابة.
الترتيب الصحيح: I do like tea.
really تعني «حقاً». مثال: I really like it.
does تعني «does (تشديد)». مثال: She does know the answer.

lessons.title: Reflexive Pronouns
lessons.descriptionAr: myself، yourself، himself، herself.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام الضمائر الانعكاسية. البنية: I hurt myself. (أذيت نفسي.). myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.

dialogue.textEn: yourself! You can do it yourself.

quiz.explanationAr: myself تعني «نفسي». مثال: I hurt myself.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: You can do it ___.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: yourself. يمكنك فعل ذلك yourself.
الترتيب الصحيح: I hurt myself.
herself تعني «نفسها». مثال: She looked at herself.
yourself تعني «نفسك». مثال: You can do it yourself.

lessons.title: Reciprocal Pronouns
lessons.descriptionAr: each other، one another.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام الضمائر التبادلية. البنية: They love each other. (هم يحبون بعضهم.). each other / one another = mutually. They help each other.

dialogue.textEn: Let us talk about each other.
each other! They love each other.
one another! We help one another.
both! Both of them are here.

quiz.explanationAr: each other تعني «بعضهم (each other)». مثال: They love each other.
الإجابة الصحيحة: one another. نساعد بعضنا.
الترتيب الصحيح: They love each other.
both تعني «كلاهما». مثال: Both of them are here.
one another تعني «بعضهم (one another)». مثال: We help one another.

lessons.title: Indefinite Pronouns
lessons.descriptionAr: someone، anyone، no one، everyone.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام الضمائر غير المحددة. البنية: Someone is at the door. (شخص ما at the door.). someone/anyone/no one/everyone. something/anything/nothing/everything.

dialogue.textEn: Someone, anyone, no one, everyone — indefinite.
dialogue.textAr: someone، anyone، no one، everyone — غير محدد.

dialogue.textEn: someone! Someone is at the door.
dialogue.textAr: شخص ما! شخص ما at the door.
أي شخص! هل أي شخص هنا؟

quiz.explanationAr: someone تعني «شخص ما». مثال: Someone is at the door.
الإجابة الصحيحة: anyone. هل أي شخص هنا؟
الترتيب الصحيح: Someone is at the door.
everyone تعني «الجميع». مثال: Everyone is happy.
anyone تعني «أي شخص». مثال: Is anyone here?

lessons.title: Quantifiers
lessons.descriptionAr: all، both، some، any.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام المحددات. البنية: All students are here. (جميع الطلاب هنا.). all (الجميع)، both (كلاهما)، some (بعض)، any (أي).

dialogue.textAr: all، both، some، any — حدد كمية.

dialogue.textEn: both! Both of them are here.

quiz.explanationAr: all تعني «الجميع». مثال: All students are here.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: ___ of them are here.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: both. كلاهما هنا.
الترتيب الصحيح: All students are here.
any تعني «أي». مثال: Do you have any?
both تعني «كلاهما». مثال: Both of them are here.

lessons.title: Determiners
lessons.descriptionAr: this، that، these، those (review).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام محددات (review). البنية: This is my book. (هذا كتابي.). this (هذا، قريب)، that (ذلك، بعيد)، these (هؤلاء، قريب)، those (أولئك، بعيد).

dialogue.textEn: This, that, these, those — point and identify.
dialogue.textAr: this، that، these، those — أشر وعرّف.

quiz.explanationAr: this تعني «هذا (قريب)». مثال: This is my book.
الإجابة الصحيحة: that. ذلك قلمك.
الترتيب الصحيح: This is my book.
those تعني «أولئك (بعيد)». مثال: Those are your pens.
that تعني «ذلك (بعيد)». مثال: That is your pen.

lessons.title: Articles 2
lessons.descriptionAr: a/an/the (review) + zero article.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام articles (review + zero). البنية: I like apples. (أحب التفاح.). a/an (غير محدد)، the (معرف)، zero article (عام: I like apples).

dialogue.textEn: The book is on the table.
A, an, the, zero — use articles correctly.
dialogue.textAr: a، an، the، zero — استخدم articles بشكل صحيح.

dialogue.textEn: the! The book is on the table.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The book is on the table.

quiz.explanationAr: a تعني «غير محدد (ساكن)». مثال: I have a book.
الإجابة الصحيحة: an. لدي تفاحة.
الترتيب الصحيح: I like apples.
article تعني «أداة». مثال: I use an article.
an تعني «غير محدد (متحرك)». مثال: I have an apple.

lessons.title: Nouns 2
lessons.descriptionAr: countable/uncountable (review) + compound nouns.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التمييز بين countable و uncountable (review). البنية: I need some water. (أحتاج بعض الماء.). Countable: a book, books. Uncountable: water, rice (no plural). Compound: toothbrush, bedroom.

dialogue.textEn: bedroom! I sleep in the bedroom.
dialogue.textAr: غرفة نوم (compound)! أنام في غرفة النوم.

quiz.explanationAr: water تعني «ماء (غير محسوس)». مثال: I need some water.
الإجابة الصحيحة: rice. آكل أرزًا.
الترتيب الصحيح: I need some water.
bedroom تعني «غرفة نوم (compound)». مثال: I sleep in the bedroom.
rice تعني «أرز (غير محسوس)». مثال: I eat rice.

lessons.title: Adjectives 2
lessons.descriptionAr: order of adjectives (size, color, noun).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: ترتيب الصفات. البنية: I have a big red ball. (لدي كرة كبيرة حمراء.). Order: size + color + noun (a big red ball). Opinion + size + color + noun.

dialogue.textEn: I have a big red ball.
Big, red, beautiful, new — order adjectives.
dialogue.textAr: big، red، beautiful، new — رتب الصفات.

dialogue.textEn: big! I have a big red ball.
new! I have a new car.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I have a big red ball.

quiz.explanationAr: big تعني «كبير». مثال: I have a big red ball.
الإجابة الصحيحة: red. الكرة حمراء.

quiz.correctAnswer: I have a big red ball.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I have a big red ball.
new تعني «جديد». مثال: I have a new car.
red تعني «أحمر». مثال: The ball is red.

lessons.title: Adverbs 2
lessons.descriptionAr: position of adverbs (before/after verb).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: موضع الظروف. البنية: She speaks English well. (هي تتحدث الإنجليزية جيدًا.). Adverb of manner: after verb/object (speak well). Frequency: before main verb (always study).

dialogue.textEn: Well, always, quickly, carefully — place adverbs.
dialogue.textAr: well، always، quickly، carefully — ضع الظروف.

quiz.explanationAr: well تعني «جيدًا». مثال: She speaks English well.
الإجابة الصحيحة: always. أدرس دائمًا.
الترتيب الصحيح: She speaks English well.
carefully تعني «بحذر». مثال: She drives carefully.
always تعني «دائمًا». مثال: I always study.

lessons.title: Verbs 2
lessons.descriptionAr: regular/irregular past (review).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: الأفعال (review + irregular). البنية: I went to the park. (ذهبت إلى الحديقة.). Regular: work→worked. Irregular: go→went, see→saw, eat→ate.

dialogue.textEn: went! I went to the park.

quiz.explanationAr: go تعني «يذهب». مثال: I go to school.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: I ___ to the park.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: went. ذهبت إلى الحديقة.
الترتيب الصحيح: I went to the park.
saw تعني «رأى (ماضي)». مثال: I saw a movie.
went تعني «ذهب (ماضي)». مثال: I went to the park.

lessons.title: Tenses 2
lessons.descriptionAr: present، past، future (review).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: مراجعة الأزمنة. البنية: I go, I went, I will go. (أذهب، ذهبت، سأذهب.). Present Simple (I go)، Past Simple (I went)، Future (I will go).

dialogue.textEn: went! I went to the park.
will go! I will go tomorrow.

dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول أنا ذاهب (present cont.)؟

dialogue.textEn: am going! I am going now.
dialogue.textAr: أنا ذاهب (present cont.)! أنا ذاهب الآن.

quiz.explanationAr: go تعني «يذهب (present)». مثال: I go to school.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: I ___ to the park.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: went. ذهبت إلى الحديقة.

quiz.correctAnswer: I go, I went, I will go.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I go, I went, I will go.
am going تعني «أنا ذاهب (present cont.)». مثال: I am going now.
went تعني «ذهب (past)». مثال: I went to the park.

lessons.title: Modal Verbs 2
lessons.descriptionAr: could، may، might، must.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: أفعال مساعدة (إضافي). البنية: You could help me. (يمكنك مساعدتي.). could (طلب/قدرة)، may (إحتمال/إذن)، might (إحتمال)، must (ضرورة).

quiz.explanationAr: could تعني «يمكنك (طلب)». مثال: You could help me.
الإجابة الصحيحة: may. قد تمطر.
الترتيب الصحيح: You could help me.
must تعني «يجب». مثال: You must study.
may تعني «قد (إحتمال/إذن)». مثال: It may rain.

lessons.title: Requests
lessons.descriptionAr: Can you…? Could you…? Would you…?
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: تقديم طلبات مهذبة. البنية: Can you help me? (هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟). Can you + verb? (informal). Could you + verb? (polite). Would you + verb? (very polite).

dialogue.textEn: Can you, could you, would you, please — make requests.
dialogue.textAr: can you، could you، would you، please — قدم طلبات.

dialogue.textEn: can you! Can you help me?
could you! Could you open the door?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك (مهذب)! هل يمكنك فتح الباب؟
هل يمكنك قول هل تفضل (مهذب جداً)؟

dialogue.textEn: would you! Would you like some tea?
dialogue.textAr: هل تفضل (مهذب جداً)! هل تود بعض الشاي؟

quiz.explanationAr: can you تعني «هل يمكنك». مثال: Can you help me?
الإجابة الصحيحة: could you. هل يمكنك فتح الباب؟
الترتيب الصحيح: Can you help me?
please تعني «من فضلك». مثال: Please help me.
could you تعني «هل يمكنك (مهذب)». مثال: Could you open the door?

lessons.title: Offers
lessons.descriptionAr: Would you like…? Shall I…? Can I…?
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: تقديم عروض. البنية: Would you like some tea? (هل تود بعض الشاي؟). Would you like + noun/verb? (عرض). Shall I + verb? (عرض). Can I + verb? (عرض).

dialogue.textEn: Would you like, shall I, can I — make offers.
dialogue.textAr: would you like، shall I، can I — قدم عروض.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say would you like?
would you like! Would you like some tea?
dialogue.textAr: هل تود! هل تود بعض الشاي؟

dialogue.textEn: shall I! Shall I open the window?
can I! Can I help you?
Can you say would you like?

quiz.explanationAr: would you like تعني «هل تود». مثال: Would you like some tea?
الإجابة الصحيحة: shall I. هل أفتح النافذة؟
الترتيب الصحيح: Would you like some tea?
like تعني «يحب». مثال: I like tea.
shall I تعني «هل أ…». مثال: Shall I open the window?

lessons.title: Requests & Offers
lessons.descriptionAr: Can you…? / Would you like…?
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: الطلبات والعروض (review). البنية: Can you help me? Would you like tea? (هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟ هل تود شايًا؟). Requests: Can/Could/Would you…? Offers: Would you like…? / Shall I…? / Can I…?

dialogue.textEn: can you! Can you help me?
Can you say would you like?
would you like! Would you like tea?
thank you! Thank you very much.

quiz.explanationAr: can you تعني «هل يمكنك». مثال: Can you help me?
الإجابة الصحيحة: would you like. هل تود شايًا؟

quiz.promptAr: هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟ هل تود شايًا؟
quiz.correctAnswer: Can you help me? Would you like tea?
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: Can you help me? Would you like tea?
thank you تعني «شكرًا». مثال: Thank you very much.
would you like تعني «هل تود». مثال: Would you like tea?

lessons.title: Describing People
lessons.descriptionAr: tall، short، kind، funny.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: وصف الأشخاص. البنية: She is tall and kind. (هي tall وkind.). Subject + is/are + adjective(s). He/She is tall/kind/funny.

dialogue.textEn: Tall, short, kind, funny — describe people.
dialogue.textAr: tall، short، kind، funny — صف الأشخاص.

quiz.explanationAr: tall تعني «طويل». مثال: She is tall.
الإجابة الصحيحة: short. هو short.
الترتيب الصحيح: She is tall and kind.
funny تعني «مضحك». مثال: He is funny.
short تعني «قصير». مثال: He is short.

lessons.title: Describing Places
lessons.descriptionAr: big، small، beautiful، crowded.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: وصف الأماكن. البنية: The city is big and beautiful. (المدينة big وbeautiful.). The + noun + is/are + adjective(s).

dialogue.textEn: Big, small, beautiful, crowded — describe places.
dialogue.textAr: big، small، beautiful، crowded — صف الأماكن.

quiz.explanationAr: big تعني «كبير». مثال: The city is big.

lessons.title: Common Idioms
lessons.descriptionAr: break the ice، hit the books، under the weather.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: فهم واستخدام idioms (meaning ≠ literal). البنية: A joke broke the ice at the meeting. (نكتة كسرت الجليد في الاجتماع.). Idiom = تعبير مجازي. لا تترجم حرفياً — احفظ المعنى.

dialogue.textEn: A joke can break the ice at the meeting.
I need to hit the books for the exam.
She is under the weather today.
The test was a piece of cake.
Break the ice, hit the books, under the weather — use them naturally.
dialogue.textAr: break the ice، hit the books، under the weather — استخدمها بشكل طبيعي.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say break the ice?
break the ice! A joke can break the ice at the meeting.
dialogue.textAr: تخفيف التوتر! نكتة يمكن أن تكسر الجليد.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say hit the books?
hit the books! I need to hit the books for the exam.
dialogue.textAr: الدراسة بجد! أحتاج إلى الدراسة بجد للامتحان.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say under the weather?
under the weather! She is under the weather today.
Can you say piece of cake?
piece of cake! The test was a piece of cake.
dialogue.textAr: سهل جداً! الاختبار كان سهلاً جداً.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say break the ice?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: A joke can break the ice at the meeting.
I need to hit the books for the exam.
She is under the weather today.
The test was a piece of cake.

quiz.explanationAr: break the ice تعني «تخفيف التوتر». مثال: A joke can break the ice at the meeting.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: I need to ___ for the exam.
quiz.questionEn: I need to ___ for the exam.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: hit the books. أحتاج إلى الدراسة بجد للامتحان.

quiz.correctAnswer: A joke broke the ice at the meeting.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: A joke broke the ice at the meeting.
piece of cake تعني «سهل جداً». مثال: The test was a piece of cake.
hit the books تعني «الدراسة بجد». مثال: I need to hit the books for the exam.

lessons.title: Idioms & Phrasal Verbs in Professional Context
lessons.descriptionAr: follow up، bring up، wrap up، move forward، reach out.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام idioms/phrasal verbs في بيئة عمل (meetings, emails). البنية: I’ll follow up with an email. (سأتابع عبر بريد إلكتروني.). follow up (متابعة)، bring up (إثارة)، wrap up (إنهاء)، move forward (المضي قدمًا)، reach out (التواصل).

dialogue.textEn: Let us use idioms at work.
I’ll follow up with an email.
Let’s bring up a new idea.
Please reach out if you need help.
Follow up, bring up, wrap up, reach out — use them at work.
dialogue.textAr: follow up، bring up، wrap up، reach out — استخدمها في العمل.

dialogue.textEn: follow up! I’ll follow up with an email.
bring up! Let’s bring up a new idea.
wrap up! Let’s wrap up the meeting.
reach out! Please reach out if you need help.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I’ll follow up with an email.
Let’s bring up a new idea.
Please reach out if you need help.

quiz.explanationAr: follow up تعني «متابعة». مثال: I’ll follow up with an email.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: Let’s ___ a new idea.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: bring up. لإثارة فكرة جديدة.

quiz.correctAnswer: I’ll follow up with an email.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I’ll follow up with an email.
reach out تعني «التواصل». مثال: Please reach out if you need help.
bring up تعني «إثارة موضوع». مثال: Let’s bring up a new idea.

lessons.title: Zero & First Conditional
lessons.descriptionAr: If + present, present (حقيقة). If + present, will (احتمال).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام Zero & First Conditional. البنية: If it rains, I will stay home. (إذا أمطرت، سأبقى في المنزل.). Zero: If + Present, Present (حقائق). First: If + Present, will + base (احتمال). unless, as long as, provided that.

dialogue.textEn: If it rains, I will stay home.
Unless you study, you will fail.
As long as you try, you’ll succeed.
Provided that it’s safe, we’ll go.
Zero & First Conditional — express facts and possibilities.
dialogue.textAr: Zero & First Conditional — عبّر عن حقائق وإمكانيات.

dialogue.textEn: if! If it rains, I will stay home.
dialogue.textAr: إذا! إذا أمطرت، سأبقى في المنزل.

dialogue.textEn: unless! Unless you study, you will fail.
dialogue.textAr: ما لم! ما لم تدرس، ستفشل.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say as long as?
as long as! As long as you try, you’ll succeed.
provided that! Provided that it’s safe, we’ll go.
dialogue.textAr: بشرط أن! بشرط أن يكون آمنًا، سنذهب.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: If it rains, I will stay home.
Unless you study, you will fail.
As long as you try, you’ll succeed.
Provided that it’s safe, we’ll go.

quiz.explanationAr: if تعني «إذا». مثال: If it rains, I will stay home.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: ___ you study, you will fail.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: unless. ما لم تدرس، ستفشل.

quiz.correctAnswer: If it rains, I will stay home.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: If it rains, I will stay home.
provided that تعني «بشرط أن». مثال: Provided that it’s safe, we’ll go.
unless تعني «ما لم». مثال: Unless you study, you will fail.

lessons.title: Second Conditional
lessons.descriptionAr: If + Past Simple, would + base (تخيل).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام Second Conditional (تخيل/أحلام). البنية: If I won the lottery, I would travel. (لو فزت باليانصيب، سأسافر.). If + Past Simple, would + base. للتخيل (غير real). If I were rich… / I wish…

dialogue.textEn: If I won, I would travel.
If only I had more time.
dialogue.textAr: لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

dialogue.textEn: would! If I won, I would travel.
if only! If only I had more time.
dialogue.textAr: لو فقط! لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

dialogue.textEn: suppose! Suppose you had a million.
wish! I wish I could fly.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: If I won, I would travel.
If only I had more time.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

quiz.explanationAr: would تعني «would (تخيل)». مثال: If I won, I would travel.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: ___ I had more time.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: if only. لو فقط كان لدي وقت أكثر.

quiz.correctAnswer: If I won the lottery, I would travel.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: If I won the lottery, I would travel.
wish تعني «أتمنى». مثال: I wish I could fly.
if only تعني «لو فقط». مثال: If only I had more time.

lessons.title: Third Conditional
lessons.descriptionAr: If + Past Perfect, would have + pp (ندم).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام Third Conditional (Vergangenheit unreal). البنية: If I had studied, I would have passed. (لو درست، لنجحت.). If + Past Perfect, would have + pp. للندم (Vergangenheit unreal). could have, should have, might have.

dialogue.textEn: If I had studied, I would have passed.
Third Conditional — express regret about the past.
dialogue.textAr: Third Conditional — عبّر عن الندم about Vergangenheit.

dialogue.textEn: had studied! If I had studied, I would have passed.
would have! I would have won.
could have! I could have tried harder.
dialogue.textAr: كان يمكن! كان يمكن أن أحاول أكثر.

dialogue.textEn: should have! You should have told me.
dialogue.textAr: كان يجب! كان يجب أن تخبرني.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: If I had studied, I would have passed.

quiz.explanationAr: had studied تعني «درس (Vergangenheit)». مثال: If I had studied, I would have passed.
الإجابة الصحيحة: would have. لقد فزت (لو).

quiz.correctAnswer: If I had studied, I would have passed.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: If I had studied, I would have passed.
should have تعني «كان يجب». مثال: You should have told me.
would have تعني «would have (ماضي)». مثال: I would have won.

lessons.title: Relative Clauses & Wish
lessons.descriptionAr: who، which، that، whose + Wish (present/past regret).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام relative clauses و Wish. البنية: The man who called is my friend. (الرجل الذي اتصل صديقي.). who (شخص)، which (شيء)، that (كلاهما)، whose (ملكية). Wish + Past Simple/Past Perfect (regret).

dialogue.textEn: The man who called is my friend.
The book which I read is great.
The car that broke down is old.
The student whose bag is lost…
Who, which, that, whose, wish — connect and regret.
dialogue.textAr: who، which، that، whose، wish — اربط واندم.

dialogue.textEn: who! The man who called is my friend.
which! The book which I read is great.
that! The car that broke down is old.
whose! The student whose bag is lost…

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The man who called is my friend.
The book which I read is great.
The car that broke down is old.
The student whose bag is lost…

quiz.explanationAr: who تعني «الذي (شخص)». مثال: The man who called is my friend.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: The book ___ I read is great.
quiz.questionEn: The book ___ I read is great.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: which. الكتاب الذي قرأته رائع.

quiz.correctAnswer: The man who called is my friend.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: The man who called is my friend.
whose تعني «التي (ملكية)». مثال: The student whose bag is lost…
which تعني «الذي (شيء)». مثال: The book which I read is great.

lessons.title: Present Perfect (vs PC)
lessons.descriptionAr: have/has + pp (نتائج/خبرة) vs have been + ing (مستمر).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التمييز بين Present Perfect و Present Perfect Continuous. البنية: I have visited Paris. (لقد زرت Paris.). Present Perfect: have/has + pp (نتائج/خبرة). Present Perfect Continuous: have/has been + ing (مستمر). for/since.

dialogue.textEn: Let us talk about experience and process.
I have been studying for 2 hours.
I have lived here for 5 years.
Present Perfect vs PC — express experience and process.
dialogue.textAr: Present Perfect vs PC — عبّر عن الخبرة والعملية.
هل يمكنك قول زار (ماضي مع نتيجة)؟

dialogue.textEn: have visited! I have visited Paris.
dialogue.textAr: زار (ماضي مع نتيجة)! لقد زرت Paris.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say have been studying?
have been studying! I have been studying for 2 hours.
for! I have lived here for 5 years.
since! I have worked here since 2020.

dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول زار (ماضي مع نتيجة)؟

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I have been studying for 2 hours.
I have lived here for 5 years.

quiz.explanationAr: have visited تعني «زار (ماضي مع نتيجة)». مثال: I have visited Paris.
الإجابة الصحيحة: have been studying. أدرس منذ ساعتين.
الترتيب الصحيح: I have visited Paris.
since تعني «من». مثال: I have worked here since 2020.
have been studying تعني «يدرس (مستمر)». مثال: I have been studying for 2 hours.

lessons.title: Future Continuous & Perfect
lessons.descriptionAr: will be + ing (مستمر)، will have + pp (تام).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام Future Continuous & Future Perfect. البنية: I will be working at 8 PM. (سأعمل في 8 مساءً.). Future Continuous: will be + ing (action in progress). Future Perfect: will have + pp (completed before future time). by (time).

dialogue.textEn: Let us talk about the future.
I will be working at 8 PM.
I will have finished by 5 PM.
By next year, I will have graduated.
At this time tomorrow, I’ll be flying.
dialogue.textAr: في هذا الوقت غدًا، سأسافر بالطائرة.

dialogue.textEn: Future Continuous & Perfect — predict the future.
will be! I will be working at 8 PM.
will have! I will have finished by 5 PM.
by! By next year, I will have graduated.
Can you say at this time tomorrow?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول في هذا الوقت غدًا؟

dialogue.textEn: at this time tomorrow! At this time tomorrow, I’ll be flying.
dialogue.textAr: في هذا الوقت غدًا! في هذا الوقت غدًا، سأسافر بالطائرة.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I will be working at 8 PM.
I will have finished by 5 PM.
By next year, I will have graduated.
At this time tomorrow, I’ll be flying.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: في هذا الوقت غدًا، سأسافر بالطائرة.

quiz.explanationAr: will be تعني «will be (مستمر)». مثال: I will be working at 8 PM.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: I ___ finished by 5 PM.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: will have. سأنتهي بحلول 5.

quiz.correctAnswer: I will be working at 8 PM.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I will be working at 8 PM.

quiz.questionAr: أي كلمة تعني «في هذا الوقت غدًا»؟
quiz.explanationAr: at this time tomorrow تعني «في هذا الوقت غدًا». مثال: At this time tomorrow, I’ll be flying.
will have تعني «will have (تام)». مثال: I will have finished by 5 PM.

lessons.title: Environment & Technology
lessons.descriptionAr: climate change، renewable energy، AI، data privacy.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التحدث عن قضايا معاصرة (البيئة، التكنولوجيا). البنية: We must reduce our carbon footprint. (يجب أن نقلل بصمتنا الكربونية.). مفردات للنقاش: climate change, renewable energy, carbon footprint, AI, data privacy, automation, sustainable.

dialogue.textEn: Let us discuss environment and technology.
Climate change is a global issue.
We must reduce our carbon footprint.
Data privacy is a growing concern.
Climate change, renewable energy, carbon footprint, data privacy — discuss with confidence.
dialogue.textAr: climate change، renewable energy، carbon footprint، data privacy — ناقش بثقة.

dialogue.textEn: climate change! Climate change is a global issue.
dialogue.textAr: تغير المناخ! تغير المناخ قضية عالمية.

dialogue.textEn: renewable energy! Solar power is renewable energy.
dialogue.textAr: طاقة متجددة! الطاقة الشمسية طاقة متجددة.

dialogue.textEn: carbon footprint! We must reduce our carbon footprint.
dialogue.textAr: بصمة كربونية! يجب أن نقلل بصمتنا الكربونية.

dialogue.textEn: data privacy! Data privacy is a growing concern.
dialogue.textAr: خصوصية البيانات! خصوصية البيانات قلق متزايد.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: Climate change is a global issue.
We must reduce our carbon footprint.
Data privacy is a growing concern.

quiz.explanationAr: climate change تعني «تغير المناخ». مثال: Climate change is a global issue.
الإجابة الصحيحة: renewable energy. الطاقة الشمسية طاقة متجددة.

quiz.correctAnswer: We must reduce our carbon footprint.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: We must reduce our carbon footprint.
data privacy تعني «خصوصية البيانات». مثال: Data privacy is a growing concern.
renewable energy تعني «طاقة متجددة». مثال: Solar power is renewable energy.

lessons.title: Health & Society
lessons.descriptionAr: mental health، well-being، healthcare، inequality، lifestyle.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التحدث عن قضايا معاصرة (الصحة، المجتمع). البنية: Mental health is as important as physical health. (الصحة النفسية مهمة بقدر الصحة الجسدية.). مفردات للنقاش: mental health, well-being, healthcare, inequality, community, lifestyle, prevent.

dialogue.textEn: Let us discuss health and society.
Mental health, well-being, inequality, lifestyle — discuss with confidence.
dialogue.textAr: mental health، well-being، inequality، lifestyle — ناقش بثقة.

dialogue.textEn: mental health! Mental health is important.
inequality! Inequality is a social issue.
dialogue.textAr: عدم مساواة! عدم المساواة قضية اجتماعية.

dialogue.textEn: lifestyle! A healthy lifestyle prevents disease.
dialogue.textAr: نمط حياة! نمط حياة صحي يمنع المرض.

quiz.explanationAr: mental health تعني «صحة نفسية». مثال: Mental health is important.
الإجابة الصحيحة: well-being. التمرين يحسّن الرفاهية.

quiz.promptAr: الصحة النفسية مهمة بقدر الصحة الجسدية.
quiz.correctAnswer: Mental health is as important as physical health.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: Mental health is as important as physical health.
lifestyle تعني «نمط حياة». مثال: A healthy lifestyle prevents disease.
well-being تعني «رفاهية». مثال: Exercise improves well-being.

lessons.title: Opinions 2
lessons.descriptionAr: I’m convinced that، It’s clear that.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التعبير عن الرأي (إضافي). البنية: I’m convinced that remote work is efficient. (أنا مقتنع أن العمل عن بعد فعال.). I’m convinced that… It’s clear that… In my view…

dialogue.textEn: I’m convinced that remote work is efficient.
dialogue.textAr: أنا مقتنع أن العمل عن بعد فعال.

dialogue.textEn: In my view, education is key.
Can you say I’m convinced that?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول أنا مقتنع أن؟

dialogue.textEn: I’m convinced that! I’m convinced that remote work is efficient.
dialogue.textAr: أنا مقتنع أن! أنا مقتنع أن العمل عن بعد فعال.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say it’s clear that?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول من الواضح أن؟

dialogue.textEn: it’s clear that! It’s clear that AI helps.
dialogue.textAr: من الواضح أن! من الواضح أن AI helps.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say in my view?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول من وجهة نظري؟

dialogue.textEn: in my view! In my view, education is key.
dialogue.textAr: من وجهة نظري! من وجهة نظري، التعليم key.

dialogue.textEn: I believe! I believe in hard work.
Can you say I’m convinced that?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول أنا مقتنع أن؟

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I’m convinced that remote work is efficient.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: أنا مقتنع أن العمل عن بعد فعال.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: In my view, education is key.

quiz.explanationAr: I’m convinced that تعني «أنا مقتنع أن». مثال: I’m convinced that remote work is efficient.
الإجابة الصحيحة: it’s clear that. من الواضح أن AI helps.

quiz.promptAr: أنا مقتنع أن العمل عن بعد فعال.
quiz.correctAnswer: I’m convinced that remote work is efficient.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I’m convinced that remote work is efficient.
I believe تعني «أعتقد». مثال: I believe in hard work.
it’s clear that تعني «من الواضح أن». مثال: It’s clear that AI helps.

lessons.title: Debating 2
lessons.descriptionAr: rebuttal، concession، refutation.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: المناظرة (إضافي). البنية: I see your point, but I disagree. (أرى وجهة نظرك، لكنني أختلف.). Rebuttal (رد)، Concession (اعتراف)، Refutation (دحض).

quiz.explanationAr: rebuttal تعني «رد». مثال: His rebuttal was strong.
الإجابة الصحيحة: concession. أقرت بـ concession.

quiz.correctAnswer: I see your point, but I disagree.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I see your point, but I disagree.
counter-argument تعني «حجة مضادة». مثال: The counter-argument is weak.
concession تعني «اعتراف». مثال: She made a concession.

lessons.title: Persuasion 2
lessons.descriptionAr: rhetorical questions، emotive language.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: الإقناع (إضافي). البنية: Isn’t it time to act? (أليس وقت العمل؟). Rhetorical questions (Isn’t it time to…?). Emotive language (urgent, crucial).

dialogue.textEn: Persuasion — use rhetorical questions and emotive language.
dialogue.textAr: الإقناع — استخدم أسئلة بلاغية ولغة عاطفية.

dialogue.textEn: rhetorical question! That is a rhetorical question.

quiz.explanationAr: rhetorical question تعني «سؤال بلاغي». مثال: That is a rhetorical question.
الإجابة الصحيحة: emotive. استخدم لغة emotive.
الترتيب الصحيح: Isn’t it time to act?
crucial تعني «حاسمة». مثال: This is crucial.
emotive تعني «عاطفية». مثال: Use emotive language.

lessons.title: Phrasal Verbs 2
lessons.descriptionAr: break down، set up، give in.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: أفعال مركبة (إضافي). البنية: The car broke down. (السيارة تعطلت.). Verb + particle. break down (تعطل)، set up (أعد)، give in (استسلم).

dialogue.textEn: Let us learn more phrasal verbs.
She will take over the project.
Break down, set up, give in, take over — phrasal verbs.
dialogue.textAr: break down، set up، give in، take over — أفعال مركبة.

dialogue.textEn: break down! The car may break down.
set up! They set up a company.
take over! She will take over the project.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: She will take over the project.

quiz.explanationAr: break down تعني «تعطل». مثال: The car may break down.
الإجابة الصحيحة: set up. أنشأوا شركة.
الترتيب الصحيح: The car broke down.
take over تعني «تولى». مثال: She will take over the project.
set up تعني «أعد/أنشأ». مثال: They set up a company.

lessons.title: Idioms 2
lessons.descriptionAr: spill the beans، hit the nail on the head، under the weather.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: تعبيرات مجازية (إضافي). البنية: He hit the nail on the head. (أصاب الهدف (hit the nail on the head).). spill the beans (كشف السر)، hit the nail on the head (أصاب الهدف)، under the weather (مريض).

dialogue.textEn: He hit the nail on the head.
highlightWords: hit the nail on the head

dialogue.textEn: He visits once in a blue moon.
Spill the beans, hit the nail, under the weather — idioms.
dialogue.textAr: spill the beans، hit the nail، under the weather — تعبيرات.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say spill the beans?
spill the beans! He spilled the beans.
Can you say hit the nail on the head?
hit the nail on the head! He hit the nail on the head.
highlightWords: hit the nail on the head

dialogue.textEn: Can you say under the weather?
under the weather! She is under the weather.

lessons.title: Formal Register
