lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التمييز بين informal و formal register. البنية: We obtained the results. (حصلنا على النتائج.). get→obtain, buy→purchase, help→assist, show→indicate, a lot of→numerous. Avoid Slang in academic writing.

dialogue.textEn: Obtain, purchase, assist, indicate — speak formally.
dialogue.textAr: obtain، purchase، assist، indicate — تحدث رسمياً.

dialogue.textEn: purchase! The company purchased new equipment.
assist! The team assisted the client.
indicate! The data indicates a trend.

quiz.explanationAr: obtain تعني «يحصل على». مثال: We obtained the results.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: The company ___d new equipment.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: purchase. اشترت الشركة معدات جديدة.
الترتيب الصحيح: We obtained the results.
indicate تعني «يشير/يدل». مثال: The data indicates a trend.
purchase تعني «يشتري». مثال: The company purchased new equipment.

lessons.title: Presentation Language
lessons.descriptionAr: Let’s move on to، To summarize، As you can see، I’d like to start by.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: تقديم عرض تقديمي احترافي. البنية: I’d like to start by thanking you. (أود أن أبدأ بشكركم.). I’d like to start by… Let’s move on to… As you can see… To summarize… To conclude…

dialogue.textEn: Let’s move on to the results.
As you can see, the graph shows growth.
dialogue.textAr: كما ترون، الرسم البياني يُظهر نموًا.

dialogue.textEn: Let’s move on, to summarize, as you can see, to conclude — present with confidence.
dialogue.textAr: let’s move on، to summarize، as you can see، to conclude — قدّم بثقة.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say let’s move on to?
let’s move on to! Let’s move on to the results.
to summarize! To summarize, sales rose.
Can you say as you can see?
as you can see! As you can see, the graph shows growth.
dialogue.textAr: كما ترون! كما ترون، الرسم البياني يُظهر نموًا.

dialogue.textEn: to conclude! To conclude, the project succeeds.
Can you say let’s move on to?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: Let’s move on to the results.
As you can see, the graph shows growth.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: كما ترون، الرسم البياني يُظهر نموًا.

quiz.questionAr: ما معنى كلمة «let’s move on to»؟
quiz.explanationAr: let’s move on to تعني «لننتقل إلى». مثال: Let’s move on to the results.
الإجابة الصحيحة: to summarize. للخلاصة، زادت المبيعات.

quiz.correctAnswer: I’d like to start by thanking you.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I’d like to start by thanking you.
to conclude تعني «للخاتمة». مثال: To conclude, the project succeeds.
to summarize تعني «للخلاصة». مثال: To summarize, sales rose.

lessons.title: Answering Questions (Q&A)
lessons.descriptionAr: That’s a great question، I’ll get back to you، To clarify…
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: الإجابة على أسئلة جمهور (Q&A) باحترافية. البنية: That’s a great question. I’ll get back to you. (سؤال ممتاز. سأعود إليك.). That’s a great question. I’ll get back to you. To clarify… I don’t have the data, but… Let me check…

dialogue.textEn: That’s a great question about ROI.
I’ll get back to you on that.
That’s a great question, I’ll get back to you, to clarify — handle Q&A like a pro.
dialogue.textAr: that’s a great question، I’ll get back to you، to clarify — تعامل مع Q&A باحتراف.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say that’s a great question?
that’s a great question! That’s a great question about ROI.
dialogue.textAr: سؤال ممتاز! سؤال ممتاز بشأن ROI.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say I’ll get back to you?
I’ll get back to you! I’ll get back to you on that.
dialogue.textAr: سأعود إليك! سأعود إليك بشأن ذلك.

dialogue.textEn: to clarify! To clarify, the cost is 5%.
Can you say let me check?
let me check! Let me check and confirm.
Can you say that’s a great question?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: That’s a great question about ROI.
I’ll get back to you on that.

quiz.questionAr: ما معنى كلمة «that’s a great question»؟
quiz.explanationAr: that’s a great question تعني «سؤال ممتاز». مثال: That’s a great question about ROI.
الإجابة الصحيحة: I’ll get back to you. سأعود إليك بشأن ذلك.

quiz.correctAnswer: That’s a great question. I’ll get back to you.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: That’s a great question. I’ll get back to you.
let me check تعني «دعني أتحقق». مثال: Let me check and confirm.

quiz.questionAr: ما معنى كلمة «I’ll get back to you»؟
quiz.explanationAr: I’ll get back to you تعني «سأعود إليك». مثال: I’ll get back to you on that.

lessons.title: Business Vocabulary
lessons.descriptionAr: ROI، deadline، stakeholder، milestone، KPI، budget، revenue.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام مفردات إدارة الأعمال (ROI, deadline, stakeholder…). البنية: We must meet the deadline. (يجب أن نفي بالموعد النهائي.). ROI (Return on Investment), deadline, stakeholder, milestone, KPI, budget, revenue.

dialogue.textEn: ROI, deadline, stakeholder, milestone — speak business fluently.
dialogue.textAr: ROI، deadline، stakeholder، milestone — تحدث في إدارة الأعمال بطلاقة.
هل يمكنك قول عائد على الاستثمار؟
عائد على الاستثمار! العائد على الاستثمار 15%.

dialogue.textEn: deadline! We must meet the deadline.
dialogue.textAr: موعد نهائي! يجب أن نفي بالموعد النهائي.
أصحاب المصلحة! أصحاب المصلحة يتوقعون نتائج.

dialogue.textEn: milestone! We reached a major milestone.

dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول عائد على الاستثمار؟

quiz.explanationAr: ROI تعني «عائد على الاستثمار». مثال: The ROI is 15%.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: We must meet the ___.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: deadline. يجب أن نفي بالموعد النهائي.
الترتيب الصحيح: We must meet the deadline.
milestone تعني «معلم/هدف». مثال: We reached a major milestone.
deadline تعني «موعد نهائي». مثال: We must meet the deadline.

lessons.title: Advanced Collocations
lessons.descriptionAr: make a decision، heavy rain، strong coffee، take a break.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام collocations (كلمات تُستخدم معاً طبيعياً). البنية: We need to make a decision. (نحتاج إلى اتخاذ قرار.). make a decision (not do). heavy rain (not strong). strong coffee (not heavy). take a break (not have).

dialogue.textEn: We need to make a decision.
Make a decision, heavy rain, strong coffee, take a break — collocate naturally.
dialogue.textAr: make a decision، heavy rain، strong coffee، take a break — تلازم بشكل طبيعي.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say make a decision?
make a decision! We need to make a decision.
dialogue.textAr: اتخاذ قرار! نحتاج إلى اتخاذ قرار.

dialogue.textEn: heavy rain! Heavy rain flooded the streets.
dialogue.textAr: مطر غزير! مطر غزير أغرق الشوارع.

dialogue.textEn: strong coffee! I drink strong coffee.
Can you say take a break?
take a break! Let’s take a break.
Can you say make a decision?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: We need to make a decision.

quiz.explanationAr: make a decision تعني «اتخاذ قرار». مثال: We need to make a decision.
الإجابة الصحيحة: heavy rain. مطر غزير أغرق الشوارع.

quiz.correctAnswer: We need to make a decision.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: We need to make a decision.
take a break تعني «أخذ استراحة». مثال: Let’s take a break.
heavy rain تعني «مطر غزير». مثال: Heavy rain flooded the streets.

lessons.title: Advanced Idioms
lessons.descriptionAr: the bottom line، think outside the box، cut corners.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام idioms متقدمة (meaning ≠ literal). البنية: The bottom line is we need more time. (الخلاصة أننا نحتاج وقتًا أكثر.). the bottom line (الخلاصة)، think outside the box (التفكير خارج الصندوق)، cut corners (اختصار)، get to the point، on the same page.

dialogue.textEn: The bottom line is we need more time.
We need to think outside the box.
The bottom line, think outside the box, cut corners, get to the point — use them naturally.
dialogue.textAr: the bottom line، think outside the box، cut corners، get to the point — استخدمها بشكل طبيعي.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say the bottom line?
the bottom line! The bottom line is we need more time.
dialogue.textAr: الخلاصة/النتيجة! الخلاصة أننا نحتاج وقتًا أكثر.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say think outside the box?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول التفكير خارج الصندوق؟

dialogue.textEn: think outside the box! We need to think outside the box.
dialogue.textAr: التفكير خارج الصندوق! نحتاج إلى التفكير خارج الصندوق.

dialogue.textEn: cut corners! Don’t cut corners on safety.
dialogue.textAr: اختصار/تقليل جودة! لا تختصر في الأمان.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say get to the point?
get to the point! Let’s get to the point.
Can you say the bottom line?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: The bottom line is we need more time.
We need to think outside the box.

quiz.explanationAr: the bottom line تعني «الخلاصة/النتيجة». مثال: The bottom line is we need more time.
الإجابة الصحيحة: think outside the box. نحتاج إلى التفكير خارج الصندوق.

quiz.correctAnswer: The bottom line is we need more time.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: The bottom line is we need more time.
get to the point تعني «الذهاب للموضوع». مثال: Let’s get to the point.

quiz.questionAr: ما معنى كلمة «think outside the box»؟
quiz.explanationAr: think outside the box تعني «التفكير خارج الصندوق». مثال: We need to think outside the box.

lessons.title: Idioms & Collocations in Professional Context
lessons.descriptionAr: follow up، bring up، wrap up، move forward، reach out.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام idioms/collocations في meetings/emails/presentations. البنية: I’ll follow up with an email. (سأتابع عبر بريد.). follow up (متابعة)، bring up (إثارة)، wrap up (إنهاء)، move forward (المضي قدمًا)، reach out (التواصل).

dialogue.textEn: Let us use idioms at work.
I’ll follow up with an email.
Let’s bring up a new idea.
Please reach out if you need help.
Follow up, bring up, wrap up, reach out — use them at work.
dialogue.textAr: follow up، bring up، wrap up، reach out — استخدمها في العمل.

dialogue.textEn: follow up! I’ll follow up with an email.
bring up! Let’s bring up a new idea.
wrap up! Let’s wrap up the meeting.
reach out! Please reach out if you need help.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I’ll follow up with an email.
Let’s bring up a new idea.
Please reach out if you need help.

quiz.explanationAr: follow up تعني «متابعة». مثال: I’ll follow up with an email.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: Let’s ___ a new idea.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: bring up. لإثارة فكرة جديدة.

quiz.correctAnswer: I’ll follow up with an email.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: I’ll follow up with an email.
reach out تعني «التواصل». مثال: Please reach out if you need help.
bring up تعني «إثارة موضوع». مثال: Let’s bring up a new idea.

lessons.title: Inversion for Emphasis
lessons.descriptionAr: Not only did he… / Rarely have I seen… / Never have I…
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام Inversion للتأكيد. البنية: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot. (ليس فقط وصل متأخراً، بل نسي أيضاً.). Negative adverb + auxiliary + subject + verb. Not only did he… Rarely have I seen… Never have I…

dialogue.textEn: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot.
dialogue.textAr: ليس فقط وصل متأخراً، بل نسي.

dialogue.textEn: Rarely have I seen such dedication.
Never have I been so impressed.
Seldom do we see such talent.
Not only, rarely, never, seldom — emphasize with inversion.
dialogue.textAr: not only، rarely، never، seldom — أكد بـ Inversion.

dialogue.textEn: not only! Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot.
dialogue.textAr: ليس فقط! ليس فقط وصل متأخراً، بل نسي.

dialogue.textEn: rarely! Rarely have I seen such dedication.
dialogue.textAr: نادراً! نادراً ما رأيت such dedication.

dialogue.textEn: never! Never have I been so impressed.
seldom! Seldom do we see such talent.
dialogue.textAr: بشكل نادر! نادراً ما نرى such talent.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: ليس فقط وصل متأخراً، بل نسي.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: Rarely have I seen such dedication.
Never have I been so impressed.
Seldom do we see such talent.

quiz.explanationAr: not only تعني «ليس فقط». مثال: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: ___ have I seen such dedication.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: rarely. نادراً ما رأيت such dedication.

quiz.promptAr: ليس فقط وصل متأخراً، بل نسي أيضاً.
quiz.correctAnswer: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot.
seldom تعني «بشكل نادر». مثال: Seldom do we see such talent.
rarely تعني «نادراً». مثال: Rarely have I seen such dedication.

lessons.title: Passive Voice in Academic Writing
lessons.descriptionAr: The experiment was conducted. It is believed that…
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام المبني للمجهول في كتابة أكاديمية. البنية: The experiment was conducted in 2023. (أُجريت التجربة في 2023.). Subject + be + past participle. It is believed that… It has been shown that… (agent غير مهم).

dialogue.textEn: Let us write in passive voice.
It is believed that the drug is effective.
It has been shown that exercise helps.
The data was collected from 100 participants.
Was conducted, it is believed, it has been shown, was collected — write academically.
dialogue.textAr: was conducted، it is believed، it has been shown، was collected — اكتب أكاديمياً.

dialogue.textEn: was conducted! The experiment was conducted in 2023.
Can you say it is believed?
it is believed! It is believed that the drug is effective.
dialogue.textAr: يُعتقد أن! يُعتقد أن الدواء فعال.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say it has been shown?
it has been shown! It has been shown that exercise helps.
dialogue.textAr: ثبت أن! ثبت أن التمرين يساعد.

dialogue.textEn: was collected! The data was collected from 100 participants.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: It is believed that the drug is effective.
It has been shown that exercise helps.
The data was collected from 100 participants.

quiz.explanationAr: was conducted تعني «أُجري (ماضي)». مثال: The experiment was conducted in 2023.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: ___ that the drug is effective.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: it is believed. يُعتقد أن الدواء فعال.
الترتيب الصحيح: The experiment was conducted in 2023.
was collected تعني «جُمع (ماضي)». مثال: The data was collected from 100 participants.
it is believed تعني «يُعتقد أن». مثال: It is believed that the drug is effective.

lessons.title: Mixed Conditionals
lessons.descriptionAr: If + Past Perfect, would (Vergangenheit condition → present result).
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام Mixed Conditionals (خلط زمنين). البنية: If I had studied, I would be rich now. (لو درست، لكنت غنيًا الآن.). Past condition + present result: If + Past Perfect, would + base. Present condition + past result: If + Past Simple, would have + pp.

dialogue.textEn: If I had studied, I would be rich now.
If I were smarter, I would have passed.
Mixed conditionals — mix times and results.
Can you say if I had studied?
if I had studied! If I had studied, I would be rich now.
dialogue.textAr: لو درست (Vergangenheit)! لو درست، لكنت غنيًا الآن.
هل يمكنك قول would be (present result)؟

dialogue.textEn: would be! I would be rich now.
dialogue.textAr: would be (present result)! لكنت غنيًا الآن.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say if I were?
if I were! If I were smarter, I would have passed.
dialogue.textAr: لو كنت (present)! لو كنت أذكى، لنجحت.
هل يمكنك قول would have (Vergangenheit result)؟

dialogue.textEn: would have! I would have passed.
Can you say if I had studied?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: If I had studied, I would be rich now.
If I were smarter, I would have passed.

quiz.questionAr: ما معنى كلمة «if I had studied»؟
quiz.explanationAr: if I had studied تعني «لو درست (Vergangenheit)». مثال: If I had studied, I would be rich now.
الإجابة الصحيحة: would be. لكنت غنيًا الآن.

quiz.correctAnswer: If I had studied, I would be rich now.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: If I had studied, I would be rich now.
would have تعني «would have (Vergangenheit result)». مثال: I would have passed.
would be تعني «would be (present result)». مثال: I would be rich now.

lessons.title: Reported Speech (Advanced)
lessons.descriptionAr: Direct → Reported: tense backshift, pronouns, time.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: استخدام Reported Speech (backshift, pronouns, time). البنية: She said she was happy. (قالت إنها سعيدة.). Direct → Reported: tense backshift (present→past, past→past perfect). Pronouns/time: I→he, today→that day.

dialogue.textEn: She said, he said, was happy, would come — report speech.
dialogue.textAr: she said، he said، was happy، would come — انقل الكلام.

dialogue.textEn: she said! She said she was happy.
he said! He said he would come.
was happy! She said she was happy.
would come! He said he would come.

quiz.explanationAr: she said تعني «قالت». مثال: She said she was happy.
الإجابة الصحيحة: he said. قال إنه سيأتي.
الترتيب الصحيح: She said she was happy.
would come تعني «سيأتي (منقول)». مثال: He said he would come.
he said تعني «قال». مثال: He said he would come.

lessons.title: Negotiation Language
lessons.descriptionAr: If we compromise… / I’m afraid that’s not acceptable. / Let’s find a middle ground.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: التفاوض (offer, counter-offer, agreement). البنية: If we compromise, we can reach a deal. (إذا تنازلنا، يمكننا التوصل إلى اتفاق.). If we compromise… I can offer… What if we…? I’m afraid that’s not acceptable. Let’s find a middle ground. That’s a fair offer. Let’s agree to…

dialogue.textEn: If we compromise, we can reach a deal.
dialogue.textAr: إذا تنازلنا، يمكننا التوصل إلى اتفاق.

dialogue.textEn: Compromise, middle ground, fair offer, agree to — negotiate professionally.
dialogue.textAr: compromise، middle ground، fair offer، agree to — تفاوض باحتراف.

dialogue.textEn: compromise! If we compromise, we can reach a deal.
dialogue.textAr: تنازل! إذا تنازلنا، يمكننا التوصل إلى اتفاق.

dialogue.textEn: middle ground! Let’s find a middle ground.
fair offer! That’s a fair offer.
agree to! Let’s agree to the terms.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: If we compromise, we can reach a deal.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: إذا تنازلنا، يمكننا التوصل إلى اتفاق.

quiz.explanationAr: compromise تعني «تنازل». مثال: If we compromise, we can reach a deal.
الإجابة الصحيحة: middle ground. لنجد أرضية مشتركة.

quiz.promptAr: إذا تنازلنا، يمكننا التوصل إلى اتفاق.
quiz.correctAnswer: If we compromise, we can reach a deal.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: If we compromise, we can reach a deal.
agree to تعني «يوافق على». مثال: Let’s agree to the terms.
middle ground تعني «أرضية مشتركة». مثال: Let’s find a middle ground.

lessons.title: Diplomatic Disagreement
lessons.descriptionAr: I understand your point, but… / With respect, I disagree.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: الاختلاف بطريقة دبلوماسية (acknowledgment + soft disagreement). البنية: I understand your point, but I disagree. (أتفهم وجهتك، لكنني أختلف.). I understand your point, but… With respect, I disagree. I see where you’re coming from, but… I’m not entirely convinced. That may be true, however…

dialogue.textEn: I understand your point, but I disagree.
That may be true, however, we must consider risks.
dialogue.textAr: قد يكون صحيحاً، jedoch، يجب أن نأخذ المخاطر بعين الاعتبار.

dialogue.textEn: I understand your point, with respect, not entirely convinced — disagree diplomatically.
dialogue.textAr: I understand your point، with respect، not entirely convinced — اختلف دبلوماسياً.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say I understand your point?
I understand your point! I understand your point, but I disagree.
dialogue.textAr: أتفهم وجهتك! أتفهم وجهتك، لكنني أختلف.

dialogue.textEn: with respect! With respect, I disagree.
Can you say not entirely convinced?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول غير مقتنع تماماً؟

dialogue.textEn: not entirely convinced! I’m not entirely convinced.
dialogue.textAr: غير مقتنع تماماً! أنا غير مقتنع تماماً.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say that may be true, however?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول قد يكون صحيحاً، jednak…؟

dialogue.textEn: that may be true, however! That may be true, however, we must consider risks.
dialogue.textAr: قد يكون صحيحاً، jednak…! قد يكون صحيحاً، jedoch، يجب أن نأخذ المخاطر بعين الاعتبار.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say I understand your point?

vocabulary.exampleSentence: I understand your point, but I disagree.
That may be true, however, we must consider risks.
vocabulary.exampleSentenceAr: قد يكون صحيحاً، jedoch، يجب أن نأخذ المخاطر بعين الاعتبار.

quiz.questionAr: ما معنى كلمة «I understand your point»؟

lessons.title: Inversion 4
lessons.descriptionAr: not only… but also، rarely، seldom.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: Inversion (إضافي). البنية: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot. (ليس فقط وصل متأخراً، بل نسي أيضاً.). Not only… but also. Rarely have I… Seldom do we…

dialogue.textEn: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot.
dialogue.textAr: ليس فقط وصل متأخراً، بل نسي.

dialogue.textEn: Rarely have I seen such dedication.
Seldom do we see such talent.
Not only, rarely, seldom, only then — inversion.
dialogue.textAr: not only، rarely، seldom، only then — Inversion.

dialogue.textEn: not only! Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot.
dialogue.textAr: ليس فقط! ليس فقط وصل متأخراً، بل نسي.

dialogue.textEn: rarely! Rarely have I seen such dedication.
dialogue.textAr: نادراً! نادراً ما رأيت such dedication.

dialogue.textEn: seldom! Seldom do we see such talent.
dialogue.textAr: قلما! نادراً ما نرى such talent.

dialogue.textEn: only then! Only then did I understand.

rarely تعني «نادراً». مثال: Rarely have I seen such dedication.

lessons.title: Passive 4
lessons.descriptionAr: be + pp، it is believed، it has been shown.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: المبني للمجهول (إضافي). البنية: The experiment was conducted in 2023. (أُجريت التجربة في 2023.). be + past participle. It is believed that… It has been shown that…

dialogue.textEn: It is believed that the drug is effective.
It has been shown that exercise helps.
The data was collected from 100 participants.
Was conducted, it is believed, it has been shown, was collected — passive.
dialogue.textAr: was conducted، it is believed، it has been shown، was collected — مبني للمجهول.

dialogue.textEn: was conducted! The experiment was conducted in 2023.
Can you say it is believed?
it is believed! It is believed that the drug is effective.
dialogue.textAr: يُعتقد أن! يُعتقد أن الدواء فعال.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say it has been shown?
it has been shown! It has been shown that exercise helps.
dialogue.textAr: ثبت أن! ثبت أن التمرين يساعد.

dialogue.textEn: was collected! The data was collected from 100 participants.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: It is believed that the drug is effective.
It has been shown that exercise helps.

quiz.explanationAr: was conducted تعني «أُجري (ماضي)». مثال: The experiment was conducted in 2023.

quiz.questionAr: أكمل الجملة: ___ that the drug is effective.
quiz.explanationAr: الإجابة الصحيحة: it is believed. يُعتقد أن الدواء فعال.
الترتيب الصحيح: The experiment was conducted in 2023.

lessons.title: Mixed Conditionals 4
lessons.descriptionAr: if I had known، if I were you.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: Mixed conditionals (إضافي). البنية: If I had known, I would have acted. (لو كنت أعلم، ل acted.). Past condition + present result: If + Past Perfect, would + base. Present condition + past result: If + Past Simple, would have + pp.

dialogue.textEn: If I had known, I would have acted.
If I were you, I would have gone.
If I had known, would have, if I were you, would be — mixed conditionals.
dialogue.textAr: if I had known، would have، if I were you، would be — mixed conditionals.

dialogue.textEn: Can you say if I had known?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول لو كنت أعلم؟

dialogue.textEn: if I had known! If I had known, I would have acted.
dialogue.textAr: لو كنت أعلم! لو كنت أعلم، ل acted.

dialogue.textEn: would have! I would have passed.
Can you say if I were you?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول لو كنت مكانك؟

dialogue.textEn: if I were you! If I were you, I would have gone.
dialogue.textAr: لو كنت مكانك! لو كنت مكانك، لذهبت.

dialogue.textEn: would be! I would be rich now.
Can you say if I had known?
dialogue.textAr: هل يمكنك قول لو كنت أعلم؟

vocabulary.exampleSentence: If I had known, I would have acted.
If I were you, I would have gone.

quiz.questionAr: ما معنى كلمة «if I had known»؟
quiz.explanationAr: if I had known تعني «لو كنت أعلم». مثال: If I had known, I would have acted.
الإجابة الصحيحة: would have. لقد نجحت (لو).

quiz.correctAnswer: If I had known, I would have acted.
quiz.explanationAr: الترتيب الصحيح: If I had known, I would have acted.
would be تعني «would be (present)». مثال: I would be rich now.
would have تعني «would have (ماضي)». مثال: I would have passed.

lessons.title: Reported Speech 4
lessons.descriptionAr: backshift، pronouns، time.
lessons.learningNoteAr: الهدف: Reported speech (إضافي). البنية: She said she was happy. (قالت إنها سعيدة.). Backshift: present→past, past→past perfect. Pronouns: I→he. Time: today→that day.

dialogue.textEn: She said, he said, was happy, would come — report speech.
dialogue.textAr: she said، he said، was happy، would come — انقل الكلام.

dialogue.textEn: she said! She said she was happy.
he said! He said he would come.
was happy! She said she was happy.
would come! He said he would come.

quiz.explanationAr: she said تعني «قالت». مثال: She said she was happy.

الترتيب الصحيح: She said she was happy.
would come تعني «سيأتي (منقول)». مثال: He said he would come.
he said تعني «قال». مثال: He said he would come.
